name: Processing Survey Results
goalName: Process the results as far as possible and put them into charts
goal: For the next step from completing a survey, the processing of the results is important. The viewer needs to be able to look at the results for a very small time and get a lot of information. The motto "Show don't tell" is also important, as images can be remembered longer than raw numbers.

normalLearnings: I can get an avergae of several numbers in Excel
I can get the median of several numbers in Excel
I can load data from an external Excel sheet
I can create several charts with numbered data
result: In the excel sheet the template is shown with the processed results. As there is a lack of results, I created two dummy results, containing very different answers to test the processing with. The numbers are processed succesfully and are shown in charts in a structured manner.<<document Processed Responses.xlsx>>
validation: I showed the processing to project members, who were very positive about the result.
contribution: This indirectly contributes to the end product, as the (processed) results are used to improve the product. Next, I will work on gathering suggestions based off of the results for potential future developers.
